description:
Evaluate an unknown or suspicious domain and return an explainable machine-actionable trust/risk decision. Uses DNS, RDAP, TLS, HTTP redirect, and local security signals to produce ALLOW / REVIEW / BLOCK with structured reasons and confidence. DNS alone does not prove phishing or malicious intent.
USE WHEN: agent encounters an unknown domain and needs a trust decision before acting.
DO NOT USE WHEN: agent needs raw DNS records only; use Domain Intelligence for operational DNS/HTTP/TLS health.

domain.description: Public domain name; localhost and IP literals are rejected.
domain.title: Domain

name: dns_intelligence

confidence.description: Confidence in the decision from 0 to 100.

evidence_complete.description: Whether all evidence sources were available.

risk_level.description: Risk level derived from observed signals.

signals.description: Evidence source states (DNS, RDAP, TLS, HTTP, threat intel).

title: Domain Risk & Trust Decision
